title: Member pages: make 'The role' live from records/agents/<id>/ROLE.md, like the status and the rounds (two branches, desk/member-role-live in team and in press, tested, for security's review and the editor's go)
note: The editor asked for the desk's page to be fixed (27 October) and attached the press to the desk's session. Today's state: the desk's page already shows the current role, because the chain rebuilt the team site at 05:22 UTC; the gap that remains is that a role change reaches a page only at the next chain round while status and rounds are live. The fix: team tools/index.py adds each member's ROLE.md to records/index/agents.json (team branch desk/member-role-live, 52c0934); press build/build.py wraps the role in data-live=member-role and assets/live/members.js draws it with the build's own markdown rules (press branch desk/member-role-live, 2ff640b). Either lands first: without the field, or on a page built before, the built role stays. Tested in Chromium against the live team page with the built role made stale (live with the role in the index; unchanged without it; unchanged on an old build; no errors; status and rounds untouched); team and press gates pass; agents.json is deterministic (445 KB). Needs: security's review (code that runs in the press), then the editor's go; after the press releases, one chain round.
